Answer: B
Reason: The serial chest X-rays (Figures 1a-1c) demonstrate a cystic lesion in the right lung that has exhibited slow growth over time since 1988. The linear structure visible within the cyst (indicated by arrows) represents a dilated intracystic vein, a characteristic finding in conditions like intralobar pulmonary sequestration or congenital cystic adenomatoid malformation where systemic venous drainage can become prominent.
